evals.prompt: Set up Vitest for my Vue 3 + Vite project — what config do I need?
evals.expected_output: Walks through vite.config.js test block, happy-dom/jsdom choice, and @vue/test-utils mounting.
expectations: Points at references for vitest-setup topic
Mentions happy-dom vs jsdom environment choice

evals.prompt: happy-dom or jsdom for my component tests? My tests check computed styles.
evals.expected_output: Recommends Vitest Browser Mode for style-dependent tests; explains happy-dom/jsdom tradeoff.
expectations: Mentions computed styles need real CSS rendering
Surfaces Vitest Browser Mode as the style-dependent option

evals.prompt: My Vue 3 E2E tests can't connect to the dev server. How do I wire Playwright to my Vite dev server?
evals.expected_output: Shows the webServer config in playwright.config.ts pointing at the Vue dev server.

evals.prompt: I need a self-contained test page that works on file:// URLs — no localhost. Can I scaffold one?
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds a fixture with no external API, no localhost, file:// URLs work.

evals.prompt: My test is flaky — assertions fire before the async component loads. How do I wait?
evals.expected_output: Tells the user to use await flushPromises() after mounting defineAsyncComponent.
expectations: Distinguishes loading state assertion (before flushPromises) from loaded state

evals.prompt: My async setup component won't render in tests. Suspense wrapper?
evals.expected_output: Shows wrapping in <Suspense> before mount, awaiting flushPromises, then findComponent.

evals.prompt: I'm testing a composable that uses onMounted. Direct call doesn't work — what helper?
evals.expected_output: Recommends withSetup host-component wrapper for composables using lifecycle hooks.
expectations: Mentions app.provide() for mocked injected dependencies

evals.prompt: createTestingPinia or setActivePinia for my Pinia store unit test?
evals.expected_output: Recommends setActivePinia(createPinia()) in beforeEach for store unit tests.
expectations: References stubActions flag for real action execution

evals.prompt: wrapper.html() is empty for my modal — it uses Teleport. How do I query it?
evals.expected_output: Tells user to query document.body or stub Teleport in unit tests.
expectations: Mentions document.body queries for integration tests
Recommends stubbing Teleport in unit tests

evals.prompt: My tests pass but production breaks — am I testing implementation details?
evals.expected_output: Explains black-box testing — test public API (props/events/slots), not internals.

evals.prompt: Should I use snapshot tests for my Vue 3 component? They keep breaking on refactor.
evals.expected_output: Explains the snapshot anti-pattern — converges on snapshot not spec; use sparingly.
expectations: Mentions tests pass on broken code
Recommends sparing use for regression only

evals.prompt: await nextTick() isn't enough — my test still has stale DOM. What's the right await?
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes nextTick (programmatic reactive state) from flushPromises (external async).
